add_elemental_features_to_dataframe: add elemental property features like atomic mass and electronegativity to a pandas DataFrame from chemical composition strings
featurize_compositions_with_matminer: featurize chemical composition strings in a DataFrame column using matminer ElementProperty to extract weighted average elemental features
extract_periodic_table_properties: extract periodic table properties including row, group, atomic radius, and Mendeleev number from composition data
review_add_el_features_function: review the add_el_features function that computes weighted mean elemental properties from XRF composition strings in a DataFrame
refactor_add_el_features_custom_columns: refactor add_el_features to support a custom list of elemental properties beyond the default six features
